entities.summary: Yegor Alekseyevich Gerasimov or Yahor Alyakseyevich Herasimaŭ is a Belarusian professional tennis player. He has a career high ATP singles ranking of world No. 65, which he achieved on 24 February 2020. 263 on 2 March 2015. He is the current No. 2 Belarusian player.
